_instructions: HELD-OUT TAPE TRUTH. Never pass this file to pipeline.scale / pipeline.room / the app; they refuse purpose != calibration / room_evidence.
Measure BEFORE looking at any model output. Use different spines/units/rooms (or at least different tape readings) from every calibration input.
Floor area tolerance 10%, wall area 15%, spine height/thickness 15% (per-sample and aggregate reported by the evaluator).
